# School of Adults

> A little school for the things life forgot to teach us. Health, wealth, travel and the rest of being an adult.

## Pages

- [Home](https://schoolofadults.com/): A little school for the things life forgot to teach us. Health, wealth, travel and the rest of being an adult.
